findings.current: He defeated a supreme being unlike any other in the thousand-year history of the Demonic Path
findings.defect: “Unlike any other” conveys that the defeated figure was unique, but softens the source’s explicit claim that the Demonic Path’s thousand-year history would never see another like him.
findings.rationale: 두 번 다시 없을 means there would never again be another; the Korean emphasizes the figure’s singularity across the past and future of the Demonic Path.
findings.replacement: He defeated an absolute being the thousand-year history of the Demonic Path would never see again

summary: The translation is faithful overall, with one small loss of the source’s emphasis on the Martial God’s unprecedented and never-to-be-repeated victory.
